critique: The render shows pale dotted expanding circular/arc patterns across the lower half, and their larger extent at 3.6s suggests expansion. However, there are no clearly readable falling rain streaks in either frame: the upper frame is almost entirely empty. The ripple pattern is also very large and dispersed rather than small, distinct impact ripples, so the connection between a raindrop landing and a ring forming is not visually convincing.

suggestions.why: Extend drop lifetime so the falling particles remain visible from the emitter through the waterline instead of disappearing before they read as rain.
Make the falling particles visibly readable as thin rain streaks against the dark background.
Reduce ripple particle speed so each generation forms a small local ripple instead of a very large frame-spanning dotted ring.
Shorten the visible ripple duration with the lower expansion speed, keeping rings compact and concentrated near their water-surface origin.
